summary: Final tests on forms-restyle-c (group-info-row + forms-restyle + batch C). iOS full suite (one simulator, serial, skipping the 4 classes that hang on the untouched base): 41 failures, 21 identical to the base; the other 20 were source-pin tests for the old announcement form / session creator (circular header buttons, translucent fields, extras ordering, disabled predicate) and were updated to the new stepper layouts, then re-run green (SessionCreator*, AnnouncementAdvanced/Attachments/TitleColor, SessionEditButtonAuthorGate). Web vitest: 53 failed / 2035 passed; failing set equals the base (recharts, dockview, AppNav, build-only tests) plus 4 files (AgentChatSwitcher, ChatThread, GroupInfoParity, SessionsMenu) that fail only under full-suite load and pass 34/34 alone on both group-info-row and forms-restyle-c. Not built by design (Jacey): chat composer / GIF / attachment pickers, group-info inline name edit and mute (colors only).
